title: The Legends of Secrets of Strixhaven

entities.name: Page
entities.description: A living piece of parchment that students try and fail to catch, with many rumored origins.

entities.name: Jadzi
entities.description: A human oracle considered the most powerful mage alive on Arcavios, who predicts snarls and star arches and spends her time repairing damage from the invasion.

entities.name: The Dawning Archaic
entities.description: The most powerful and dangerous archaic, formed from the soul of the last-ever oracle and suffering paradoxical fluxes from temporal instability.

entities.name: Abigale
entities.description: A deaf owlin Silverquill student and poet who signs and uses a hearing aid that transmits speech telepathically.

entities.name: Ennis
entities.description: A human Silverquill debater who beat exasperated professors and now leads the debate club.

entities.name: Nita
entities.description: A retired Silverquill professor who is now a conciliator at the Forum of Amity.

entities.name: Shadrix Silverquill
entities.description: One of the five elder dragon founders of Strixhaven, a master wordsmith who oversees diplomacy at the Forum of Amity.

entities.name: Ral Zarek
entities.description: A planeswalker and Ravnican attorney who is a guest lecturer at Silverquill, teaching animamancy.

entities.name: Killian Lu
entities.description: A Silverquill graduate student mentoring younger students at the Forum of Amity, who supported allies during the invasion.

entities.name: Scriv
entities.description: An inkling created at the Forum of Amity to enforce a diplomatic agreement and who now monitors its contracts and treaties.

entities.name: Sanar
entities.description: A goblin creative who flits between half-finished projects and flourishes at Strixhaven.

entities.name: Orysa
entities.description: A merfolk from the Pinzari Isles who summons elemental creatures and leads the Twirling Turtle Troupe.

entities.name: Zaffai
entities.description: A human grand maestro of the Strixhaven Orchestra of the Arcane who forms the Tempests at Summitfest.

entities.name: Galazeth Prismari
entities.description: One of the five elder dragon founders of Strixhaven, whose idea founded the university and who was the first to leave it to itself.

entities.name: Rootha Squallheart
entities.description: An orc and perfectionist who feels conflicted after the invasion and fixates on her failures in the Invocation of the Founders.

entities.name: Muddle
entities.description: An unfinished Prismari elemental creation that developed its own consciousness and adapts to other works.

entities.name: Kirol
entities.description: An athletic vampire Lorehold student who loves ruins and history and is conflicted by family expectations.

entities.name: Mica
entities.description: A human Lorehold historian who studies deep history through fossils, minerals and sediment.

entities.name: Aziza
entities.description: A djinni star athlete and captain of the Lorehold Mage Tower team.

entities.name: Velomachus Lorehold
entities.description: One of the five elder dragon founders of Strixhaven, who documents history without interfering and collects artifacts.

entities.name: Quintorius Kand
entities.description: A loxodon Lorehold student and recently sparked planeswalker who investigates the Fomori and returns to guide younger students at the Fields of Strife.

entities.name: Excava
entities.description: The animated statue spirit of a Blood Age war horse that lets only the valorous ride her.

entities.name: Augusta
entities.description: A Lorehold dean who died in the invasion but, through a ritual, returned as a spirit and serves as interim dean of order.

entities.name: Soovril
entities.description: An orc chronomancy student who restores historical artifacts to pristine condition.

entities.name: Tam
entities.description: A gorgon second-year Quandrix student who uses paradox magic to rewrite probability.

entities.name: Emil
entities.description: An elf from the forests of Eljor who leads the Outdoor Urbanists.

entities.name: Berta
entities.description: A burrog professor who researches the Paradox Gardens with fractal models.

entities.name: Tanazir Quandrix
entities.description: One of the five elder dragon founders of Strixhaven, a visionary thinker focused on systemic solutions.

entities.name: Zimone Wola
entities.description: A mathematical prodigy and Duskmourn survivor who graduated from Quandrix and begins a fellowship on Ravnica.

entities.name: Primo
entities.description: A wolflike fractal companion that Zimone summoned and never unsummoned, who became her defender.

entities.name: Dean Nev
entities.description: A merfolk Quandrix dean and twin of Adrix, focused on the physical manifestation of abstract theory.

entities.name: Adrix
entities.description: Nev's twin and fellow Quandrix dean.

entities.name: Kianne
entities.description: A former Quandrix dean who died.

entities.name: Imbraham
entities.description: A former Quandrix dean who died.

entities.name: Anina
entities.description: A human graduate student interested in hydralike creatures and fractal repetition in nature.

entities.name: Lluwen
entities.description: An elf from Lorwyn who betrayed his superiors to help Strixhaven students and then joined them as a student.

entities.name: Arnyn
entities.description: A vampire Witherbloom student who cultivates carnivorous plants.

entities.name: Moseo
entities.description: A skeleton osteomancer who was nearly compleated, cut out the Phyrexian influence, and became the new dean of the vein.

entities.name: Rinata
entities.description: Moseo's skeleton pest.

entities.name: Valentin
entities.description: A Witherbloom dean who died as a frontline medic and was replaced by Moseo.

entities.name: Blech
entities.description: A beloved oversized pest of the Witherbloom bayou, spawn of Blex.

entities.name: Blex
entities.description: An oversized escaped pest once used for hazing who died in the invasion.

entities.name: Beledros Witherbloom
entities.description: One of the five elder dragon founders of Strixhaven, a patient observer and the second to leave it to the professors.

entities.name: Dellian Fel
entities.description: A Witherbloom professor and necromancy pioneer who rose from the grave after thirteen months with a planeswalker's spark.

entities.name: Dina
entities.description: A darkly humorous tea-obsessed dryad who was the sole survivor of a glade hit by the Brittleblight.

entities.name: Gorma
entities.description: A pest freed in Titan's Grave who developed an appetite for anything.

entities.name: Plargg
entities.description: A Lorehold dean known for chaotic ways.

entities.name: Strixhaven University
entities.description: The university on Arcavios founded by five elder dragons.

entities.name: Arcavios
entities.description: The plane where Strixhaven stands.

entities.name: Forum of Amity
entities.description: A place for diplomacy where Shadrix, Nita and Killian work.

entities.name: Fields of Strife
entities.description: A Blood Age battlefield where Excava died and Quint guides students.

entities.name: Titan's Grave
entities.description: A place with carnivorous flora and where Gorma lurks.

entities.name: Paradox Gardens
entities.description: Gardens where Berta researches the impact on creatures.

entities.name: Pinzari Isles
entities.description: Islands home to Orysa and the merfolk twins Nev and Adrix.

entities.name: Eljor
entities.description: A forested region that is Emil's home.

entities.name: Silverquill
entities.description: The Strixhaven college of words and leadership.

entities.name: Prismari
entities.description: The Strixhaven college of elemental art.

entities.name: Lorehold
entities.description: The Strixhaven college of history and spirits.

entities.name: Quandrix
entities.description: The Strixhaven college of mathematics and nature.

entities.name: Witherbloom
entities.description: The Strixhaven college of life, death and decay.

entities.name: The Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: The attack that killed many on Arcavios and shaped the characters.

entities.name: The Brittleblight
entities.description: A plague that struck Dina's dryad glade.

entities.name: The Fomori
entities.description: Mysterious multiversal colonizers lost to time, whom Quint investigates.

events.summary: Jadzi, burdened by guilt over not predicting the invasion, now wanders the plane repairing damage.
events.quote: She harbors a quiet guilt that she was unable to predict and protect the plane more from the Phyrexian Invasion

events.summary: The Dawning Archaic, formed from the soul of the last oracle, is sundered from mana and time by an unknown phenomenon.
events.quote: The Dawning Archaic was formed from the soul of what will be the last-ever oracle on the plane.

events.summary: Ennis bests professors in debate and is urged to lead the debate club.
events.quote: After he bested a number of exasperated professors in arguments

events.summary: During the invasion Killian focuses on bolstering his allies.
events.quote: During the invasion, Killian knew his magic could not overpower the Phyrexians alone, and he focused on bolstering his allies.

events.summary: Scriv is created at the Forum of Amity to enforce a delicate diplomatic agreement and takes over monitoring its other contracts.
events.quote: Scriv is an inkling initially created at the Forum of Amity to moderate and enforce a particularly delicate diplomatic agreement.

events.summary: Zaffai forms the Tempests with graduate students to stage an atmospheric display at Summitfest.
events.quote: he and a number of his most daring graduate students have formed the Tempests

events.summary: Galazeth founds Strixhaven with an idea and is first to leave it to its own devices.
events.quote: The founding of Strixhaven was initially Galazeth's idea, yet he was also the first to leave the university to its own devices.

events.summary: Rootha fixates on her perceived failures in the Invocation of the Founders and delays her graduation.
events.quote: Rootha has delayed her graduation, unable to finish the thesis she has lingered on for years.

events.summary: Kirol decides exploring and preserving history is more important after the invasion's losses.
events.quote: after the losses of the Phyrexian Invasion, they felt that exploring and preserving history was more important than ever

events.summary: Lluwen betrays his superiors in Lorwyn to help Strixhaven students and then joins them as a student.
events.quote: Most recently, he betrayed his superiors in Lorwyn to help a group of Strixhaven students

events.summary: Quint follows the trail of the Fomori back to Arcavios and guides younger students at the Fields of Strife.
events.quote: He's been investigating the remnants of the Fomori, mysterious multiversal colonizers lost to time.

events.summary: Augusta prepares a ritual so she can be summoned after her death and returns as a spirit after dying in the invasion.
events.quote: despite her death in the Phyrexian Invasion, her spirit still serves as the interim dean of order

events.summary: Nev and Adrix are appointed Quandrix deans after the deaths of Kianne and Imbraham.
events.quote: After the deaths of Kianne and Imbraham, the two were appointed as deans of Quandrix

events.summary: Zimone graduates from Quandrix and begins a fellowship on Ravnica.
events.quote: graduated from Quandrix and has begun a new fellowship on Ravnica

events.summary: Zimone summons Primo, then refuses to unsummon him after returning from Duskmourn.
events.quote: she found herself unwilling to unsummon him

events.summary: Moseo is nearly compleated, excises the Phyrexian influence and is left as a skeleton.
events.quote: was nearly compleated during the Phyrexian Invasion

events.summary: Moseo replaces the deceased Valentin as dean of the vein.
events.quote: Moseo willingly stepped up to replace the deceased Valentin as the new dean of the vein.

events.summary: Blex is killed in the invasion and, soon after, a lookalike, Blech, appears.
events.quote: Finally, Blex was retrieved in the most tragic way possible: as a victim of the Phyrexian Invasion.

events.summary: Dellian Fel is found dead in his lab and rises from the grave thirteen months later with a planeswalker's spark.
events.quote: he rose from the grave

events.summary: Dina survives the Brittleblight alone, and later fails to restore her glade.
events.quote: She was the sole survivor of a dryad glade hit by the Brittleblight

events.summary: A student frees Gorma into Titan's Grave instead of consuming her, and she develops a huge appetite.
events.quote: the student couldn't do it, instead setting her free into the wilds of Titan's Grave
